title: 12 Best Lisbon Street Food & Time Out Market
description: Explore Lisbon's vibrant street food scene and the iconic Time Out Market. Discover the best pasteis de nata, bifanas, and seafood spots for an authentic culinary adventure.

places.name: Time Out Market Lisboa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bacalao à Brás (from Miguel Castro e Silva) or a fresh seafood dish (from Marisqueira Azul)

places.name: Manteigaria (Chiado)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pastel de Nata (served warm with cinnamon)

places.name: As Bifanas do Afonso
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Bifana (pork sandwich), add mustard for an extra kick.

places.name: Pastéis de Belém
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order At least two Pastéis de Belém, fresh from the oven, with cinnamon and powdered sugar.

places.name: Ginjinha Espinheira
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ginjinha com elas (with cherries) or sem elas (without) in a chocolate cup.

places.name: O Prego da Peixaria (Time Out Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Prego de Atum (tuna steak sandwich) or Prego de Salmão (salmon steak sandwich).

places.name: Sea Me Peixe na Brasa (Time Out Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled Sardines (seasonal) or the daily catch, often served with simple potatoes and salad.

places.name: Croqueteria (Time Out Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A mix of their gourmet croquettes, particularly the codfish (bacalhau) and alheira (smoked sausage) varieties.

places.name: Mercado de Campo de Ourique
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try some petiscos (Portuguese tapas) from a local vendor or fresh seafood from the fishmongers who also cook to order.

places.name: Fábrica da Nata
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A warm Pastel de Nata with a 'Galao' (milky coffee).

places.name: Gelados Santini
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Scoops of seasonal fruit flavors like mango, passion fruit, or classic chocolate and hazelnut.

places.name: Casa Portuguesa do Pastel de Bacalhau
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'pastel de bacalhau com queijo' (codfish cake with cheese), perhaps paired with a glass of chilled Port wine.
